verdict.rationale: Fern ships a first-party Fern Agent that reads the docs site's source repository and makes the changes you describe, opening pull requests. It can be kicked off from Slack or run on a schedule to review feedback and analytics, so users can delegate tasks to a built-in assistant. Ask Fern also offers end-user Q&A with citations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Fern Agent's task execution, and fuller documentation of where it is invoked in-product and what task scope it covers beyond docs-repo edits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Fern Agent reads your docs site’s source repository and makes the changes you describe.
Automations can review your reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries, or analytics, report back what it found, and open a pull request when the prompt asks for a change.
Slack to kick off PRs based on internal team discussions or customer troubleshooting
